description: The bar chart illustrates classification accuracy percentages for several methods listed in the legend. The category axis is horizontal with unlabeled positions corresponding to the six legend entries, and the value axis is vertical labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale ranging from about 35% to 65%, with regularly spaced tick marks every 5% (40%, 45%, 50%, 55%, 60%, 65%) and dotted horizontal gridlines. There are six single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: a light gray bar for “RoBERTa w/o Exp.” at approximately 46%, a light blue bar for “ExEnt” at approximately 55%, an orange bar for “LaSQuE (mean)” at approximately 47%, a green bar for “LaSQuE” at approximately 47%, a purple bar for “LaSQuE (syn2real)” at approximately 59%, and a dark gray bar for “LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)” at approximately 62%. The bars appear in the same left-to-right order as the legend items and are not otherwise annotated or visually emphasized beyond their distinct colors.
